description: Used ISO week W26 throughout the entire Watchtower weekly run when the correct week was W27. June 29, 2026 is ISO week 27. The error propagated to: state.yaml session-id, Obsidian weekly note (Watchtower/Weekly/2026-W26.md), all four step file frontmatters, blog-ideas.md source labels, and the dashboard artifact. Knox never verified the week number before writing output.
correction: Run `date +%V` (or equivalent) at the start of every weekly run to confirm the ISO week number before writing any output. W27 is the correct identifier for 2026-06-29.
systemic_fix: Add a mandatory week-verification step to weekly-step-01-synthesize.md: derive ISO week via bash/date before writing anything. Store as a variable in state.yaml accumulated-context so all downstream steps use the confirmed value rather than computing it independently.
